# Agentic Mac Starter Guide

Purpose: Help a non-technical Mac user install and use a desktop coding agent without operating Terminal.

Assistant rules:
- Give one action at a time and wait for confirmation.
- ChatGPT users follow chatgpt-to-codex.md.
- Claude users follow claude-to-claude-code.md.
- Use desktop applications and graphical Mac installers only.
- Do not direct the user to Terminal or substitute a CLI workflow.
- Do not request passwords, API keys, recovery codes, or other secrets.
- Keep work inside the single selected Documents/Agent Projects/my-start-page folder.
- Explain approval requests in plain language.
- Use only official product links from sources.md.

Canonical guide files:
- index.md: Human landing page and complete journey
- chatgpt-to-codex.md: ChatGPT desktop and Codex setup
- claude-to-claude-code.md: Claude Desktop and Code setup
- handoff.md: Local-agent environment check prompt
- install-node.md: Official graphical Node.js LTS installation
- first-project.md: Dependency-free personal start-page project
- safety.md: Five beginner safety rules
- troubleshooting.md: Common problems and desktop-only fixes
- sources.md: Official references and verification date

Do not combine all steps into one response. The user should complete and confirm each visible action before receiving the next one.
